verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a first-party way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows. The Rules Engine covers admin controls over meeting access and privacy, webhooks and Zapier are event-driven triggers or external tools, and calendar auto-join is a meeting-capture behavior rather than a user-defined recurring schedule. These are adjacent features, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
